## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ReusableDataMapper`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `reusable`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ReusableDataMapper**.

## Step 2: Reusable Data Mapper

1. Open the **Artifacts** page and select **Data Mapper** under **Other Artifacts**, or select **+** next to **Data Mappers** in the left sidebar.
2. <!-- manual: Fill in the Create New Data Mapper form. -->
3. Select **Create**. The data mapper canvas opens with input fields on the left and output fields on the right.
4. <!-- manual: Use the data mapper canvas to map fields. See [Mapping capabilities](../mapping-capabilities.md) for connecting fields, writing expressions, and AI-assisted mapping. -->
